  "required_fixes": [
    "R1 — Correct the file-workflow assessment and finish its scope disposition. D045 (docs/planning/decisions.md:1298-1299), the remediation report and packet limitations say the pinned SDK has no file upload. In fact, RuntimeClient::create_file in scm-sdk-0.1.0/src/airs/gateway/runtime_audio.rs:214 sends multipart POST /files; runtime.rs:12 imports that implementation under the already-enabled gateway feature. I verified these sources against the crate archive whose SHA-256 equals Cargo.lock's 6d555d955c3734dd5ee78f7173569bdecd4426095b2ffedc4b77d8f0f2c2e8d9. Thus the matrix does not establish that milestone 1's supported file workflows are unavailable. Acceptance: correct the SDK capability matrix and provide an explicit, reviewable disposition of the file requirement based on the actual product scope and retention/attachment decision. Either qualify the applicable bounded file subset with its required fixtures, or record the authorized exclusion consistently in the chunk/design/test scope. A new file implementation is not required merely to correct this finding, but the current unavailable-method justification cannot support full C18 completion.",
    "R2 — Show when a Responses answer is incomplete. gateway_inference.rs:418-424 records response.incomplete only in finish, then :668 settles it as RunEnd::Completed. playground.tsx:113-121 always renders that state as 'Completed.' and :390-414 never displays finish. The integration fixture explicitly produces state=completed, finish=max_output_tokens and output='part'; an independent in-memory render of that legitimate snapshot showed 'Completed.' with no finish reason. The operator cannot distinguish a complete answer from one cut short by the token limit. Acceptance: visibly and accessibly identify an incomplete Responses answer and its sanitized reason, including max_output_tokens, while retaining partial output, usage and trace. Preserve the correct remote outcome that the Gateway answered; do not turn it into NotSent or automatically retry. Add an App-level assertion and relevant native evidence distinguishing completed, incomplete and failed Responses runs."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [
    "G1 — Responses qualification currently misses the operator-visible incomplete case. The unit/integration tests inspect finish but accept state=completed; the App test covers modelFailed and native C18-N12 covers a successful completed response. Extend the causal test/native evidence for R2 and bind refreshed results to the resulting source. File fixture requirements must likewise agree with the corrected disposition in R1."
  ],
  "optional_suggestions": [],
  "limitations": [
    "All four supplied fingerprints recompute exactly. Verified 596 source-inventory entries, 316 referenced hashes, command logs/artifacts, before/after input hashes, intended command sequences and the passing C17 predecessor receipt/request/verdict/raw-output bindings.",
    "Attempt-01 R1-R5 are addressed by the inspected changes and refreshed evidence: native-owned draft-ID editing offline with pending-save flushing; SDK opening outcomes preserved with unknown-run recovery records; immediate credential-retirement withdrawal; query-bound/capped log pagination; and known, workspace-specific Gateway hold reconciliation. Independent in-memory probes confirmed offline editing controls, one save on immediate unmount, and continuation of the applied log query.",
    "Supplied results report 378 desktop tests, 176 core library tests, 12 Gateway inference integration tests and passing scoped Gateway change/read, credential and IPC regressions. All 28 mutation probes report named guard failures; nine input source hashes match and four baseline targets passed three times each. These are inspected implementer-run results, not independently rerun application tests.",
    "The 12 C18 native checks and C01-C17 regression records report pass against fixture executable 42e9541a90c29de82ccd406b26ba27774000358520037c762c58436b62dcb1e4. Inspected the native driver, observations and relevant Accessibility trees. N09 now exercises an offline edit across a second relaunch and reopening online without inference replay. Native acceptance was not independently rerun; spoken VoiceOver output is not recorded.",
    "The original T20 registration remains unchanged. Acceptance samples recompute within its limits: first output p95 40.768 ms, 64 KiB completion p95 31.765 ms, stop p95 26.743 ms, responsiveness p95 24.907 ms, charts p95 117.689 ms and maximum process-tree RSS 439.4 MiB. Measurements concern the supplied synthetic workload and fixture bytes; original calibration failures remain retained.",
    "Independent React/JSDOM probes executed production component source entirely in memory with presentation/native-boundary stubs. They confirmed the incomplete-answer presentation defect; they do not establish real WebView behavior. The SDK file-upload finding is backed by the checksum-matching published crate archive, not a neighboring SDK worktree.",
    "The architecture continues to keep inference, scoped observation and persistence behind Rust authority, reusing the protected credential lifecycle without a new dependency or shipped JavaScript backend. Live service qualification remains C25 and signed installed-package qualification C26. C16's separate passing re-review is still required before P05 completion.",
    "No application source was changed, product endpoints called or credentials accessed. No application build or on-disk application test was run for this review. Only the designated verdict artifact was written."
  ],
